summary: BIO-key International filed an 8-K reporting the reconvened 2026 annual meeting held October 2, 2026, after adjournment from September 3, 2026. Stockholders approved Proposals 1-3: electing five directors (DePasquale, Wong, Michel, Alia, Williams), ratifying M&K CPAs as auditor for FY2026, and an advisory vote. Quorum was 606,778 shares, or 55.8% of 1,087,360 outstanding. Proposal 4, seeking Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) approval for up to 1,236,668 shares issuable upon warrant exercise from the August 10, 2026 inducement, remains open. Watch the follow-up 8-K for Proposal 4 results and related dilution.
